scope: Chromium harness; roster/CSS/old fill handler are fixtures. No live SillyTavern, production submit or card build tested.

results.name: Eight exact preset dates and one March 3 default
Opening restoration ignores earlier background dates and rejects ambiguous/missing fields
Custom dates remain exact; invalid/multiple dates never silently default
Generated HTML has no script/inline handlers; range has no submit name
Before JS initialization: old chips visible, enhancer hidden
Startup enhances before any HUD exists and never fills/commits an empty field
Every preset writes its exact value once; input followed by change is deduplicated
Manual June 7 remains June 7; a parked thumb has an explicit apply button
Out-of-range/invalid custom text remains untouched and visibly marked
Dynamically rendered second menu initializes and changes only its own field
Reinstallation/re-rendering leaves one effective handler; existing custom text survives
Replacing inner output controls reinitializes their bindings
Native ArrowRight keyboard changes exactly one preset
Iframe-owned listener uses the chat host document and cleans up on owner pagehide
Old menus without enhancer remain unchanged
Malformed enhancer retains the existing chips
A setter failure degrades enhancement and preserves a working old entry
